identity: substrateID + canonical integer patchID; preserve source values/types; identity never numeric input except categorical patchID
position_status: SHARED_WITHIN_SUBSTRATE_REGION_CATEGORY_DOCUMENTED; physical geometry/orientation/spacing unverified; do not import D2 ROI map
category_origin: all 32 IDs observed in author TRAIN file and common region naming in official train/substrate/patch structure; no test target used
unknown_ID_policy: all-zero one-hot and ID prior=0; count unknown IDs
outer_folds: author foldNo 0..4 verified substrate-constant; no substrate overlaps; no patchwise folds
PL_features: 12 absolute summaries plus the SAME 12 within-substrate robust relative summaries =24 optical columns; identical optical block for PL-only and combined; no feature selection
windows: early/late ceil(0.10*n)=72 points; middle [floor(0.25*n):ceil(0.75*n)]; slope against linspace(0,1,n); integral trapezoid dx=1 frame index; no seconds or wavelength spectra
relative_formula: (x-current substrate optical median)/max(1.4826*current substrate optical MAD,max(1e-12,0.01*median(abs(training optical feature))))
batch_assumption: all available LP725 region signals in current substrate visible; no current substrate JV, targets or label availability in relative context
nonfinite_policy: require length719; linearly interpolate partial nonfinite signals by frame index with nearest finite endpoints; all-nonfinite ->0 signal; no row removal; record all counts; unexpected length blocks
scaler: StandardScaler fitted only on outer training substrate optical rows; no test fit

pairwise.tolerance_rule: strict abs(delta PCE)>0.5; <=0.5 excluded from training only
pairwise.pairs: all within-training-substrate unordered pairs; both orientations; same pair IDs/weights in all three input ablations
pairwise.weights: equal contributing substrate total weight; equal pair weights within each substrate; normalize overall weights mean=1

ID_prior.formula: sum(PCE - mean labeled PCE of same TRAIN substrate)/(count+5)

simple_rules.selection: outer-training-only inner author folds; rules have no fit; equal substrate mean Spearman; tie by mean Top25 gain then rule ID; save every inner substrate result; final author-test rule selected using TRAIN5fold only

author_knn_aux.input: full raw LP725719, no scaling like P1
author_knn_aux.selection: nested remaining author folds within outer train, minimum equal-inner-fold MAE and smaller k on ties; final TRAIN5fold k frozen before author-test prediction; no ranking tuning

metrics.eligibility: n>=4 finite target labels; no value-based exclusions; same candidates all models
metrics.rho: average-rank Spearman; constant score or target ->NA; report coverage
metrics.ties: descending score then ascending label-independent sample_id; same for true Top-k ties
metrics.gain: selected Top-k true PCE mean minus same substrate ALL eligible target mean
metrics.aggregation: each substrate equal; folds only additional reporting, never fold-weighted main macro

random_expectation: analytic rho0 if target nonconstant else NA, gain0, overlap k/n; exact per-substrate variance rho=1/(n-1), gain=(1-k/n)*sampleVar(PCE)/k, overlap=hypergeometric variance/k^2; not a constant-score prediction

bootstrap.meaning: descriptive finite reused-group interval; author-test n12 unstable; never patches/pairs as independent units

test_policy: audit schema/identity first; predict from optical-only API and freeze scores BEFORE label merge/scoring; one frozen evaluation plus identical deterministic replay, no tuning after test scores
